channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Minister gets history wrong on tobacco enforcement
item.description: Australia’s tobacco enforcement debate has come under scrutiny after an AAP fact-check challenged claims that previous governments failed to invest in tackling illicit tobacco. (Published on October 20, 2026byaap.com.au)

item.title: Generational Tobacco Ban
item.description: Generational tobacco bans are gaining momentum worldwide, with the UK and Maldives introducing legislation to permanently restrict tobacco sales to people born after specific dates. Similar measures are under consideration in Canada, Ireland, Türkiye and Vietnam, while New Zealand previously repealed its proposed ban. (Published on October 20, 2026bytobaccoinsider.com)

item.title: Popcorn Lung Myth: Why Health Sites Still Get It Wrong
item.description: The persistent association between vaping and “popcorn lung” highlights how incomplete scientific communication can distort perceptions of health risks. (Published on October 20, 2026bytobaccoharmreduction.net)

item.title: Worse Than Big Tobacco - The Researchers Helping to Protect Cigarette Sales
item.description: Research from the University of Stirling examining restrictions on retail displays of vapes and nicotine pouches has prompted criticism over its focus on reducing product appeal without assessing potential consequences for smoking cessation. (Published on October 20, 2026bysubstack.com)
